GREK 101.description: Classical and Hellenistic Greek, Part I.

GREK 102.description: Classical and Hellenistic Greek, Part II. Prerequisite: GREK_V 101.

GREK 201.description: Completion of the grammatical foundations of Ancient Greek, Part I. Prerequisite: GREK_V 102.

GREK 202.description: Completion of the grammatical foundations of Ancient Greek, Part II; introduction to the reading of unadapted passages of Greek literature. Prerequisite: GREK_V 201.

GREK 351.description: Readings in the major authors in Greek prose. Prerequisite: GREK_V 202.

GREK 352.description: Readings in the major authors in Greek verse. Prerequisite: GREK_V 202.

GREK 401.description: Studies in history, philosophy and/or oratory. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 401, GREK_V 501. Prerequisite: One of GREK_V 351, GREK_V 352. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GREK 402.description: Studies in epic, tragedy and/or comedy. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 402, GREK_V 502. Prerequisite: One of GREK_V 351, GREK_V 352. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GREK 403.course_name: Studies in Ancient Greek Prose and Verse
GREK 403.description: Thematic studies using both Greek prose and Greek verse. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 403, GREK_V 503. Prerequisite: One of GREK_V 351, GREK_V 352. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GREK 501.description: History, philosophy and/or oratory. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 401, GREK_V 501. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GREK 502.description: Epic, tragedy and/or comedy. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 402, GREK_V 502. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

GREK 503.course_name: Studies in Ancient Greek Prose and Verse
GREK 503.description: Advanced thematic studies using both Greek prose and Greek verse. A maximum of 12 credits can be granted for either one of or any combination of GREK_V 403, GREK_V 503. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
